_comment: Role requirement profiles for the 7 preset roles (curated by the team). required_skills are core for the role; preferred_skills are a plus. Names must match skills.txt / skill_catalog.json. These describe typical entry-to-mid level expectations, not a specific employer.

AI Engineer.description: Builds and deploys AI features: machine learning and NLP models, LLM and retrieval systems, and the APIs and infrastructure that serve them.

Machine Learning Engineer.description: Designs, trains, evaluates and productionises machine learning models with reliable data pipelines and monitoring.

Data Scientist.description: Turns data into decisions with statistics, experiments, machine learning and clear communication of findings.

Software Engineer.description: Designs, builds and maintains reliable software, from APIs and databases to user interfaces, with tests and good engineering practice.

Backend Developer.description: Builds secure, scalable server-side applications: APIs, databases, caching, messaging and deployment.

Frontend Developer.description: Builds accessible, responsive and fast user interfaces and connects them to backend APIs.

Data Analyst.description: Collects, cleans and analyses data, builds reports and dashboards, and explains findings to stakeholders.
